svg.aria-label: Vim Extras, rows & menus: 3gj numbers that count screen rows; Ctrl-N Ctrl-N / Ctrl-P in every menu
svg.title: Vim Extras, rows & menus: 3gj numbers that count screen rows; Ctrl-N Ctrl-N / Ctrl-P in every menu

text.tspan: Notes wrap, so most people move with gj and
gk: 5gj goes five screen rows down, and the
plain line numbers never say where that is.
Here every screen row has its own number,
so you see the count before you jump.
